## Architecture Overview

```
NEXRAD Radar (AWS S3)
        ↓
NEXRADDownloader (s3fs)
        ↓
RadarPreprocessor (quality control)
        ↓
PySTEPSEngine (optical flow + extrapolation)
        ↓
GridManager (caching + point extraction)
        ↓
API Endpoint (/api/v2/nowcast/precipitation)
        ↓
NowcastCache (SQLite, 5min TTL)
        ↓
MRMS Verification (skill scores)
        ↓
Prometheus Metrics → Grafana Dashboard
```
